multiplechoiceresponse.p: A workflow saves 10 minutes and adds 15 minutes of review. What should the manager conclude?

choice.div: It is a net loss; redesign the check or do not proceed.
It is a success because the automated step is faster.
The team should skip the review.

div.p: The process, not the step, is the unit of improvement. Skipping review transfers risk to someone else.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Where is most elapsed time usually lost in a process?

div.p: Assistants compress actual work, not queues. Measure before assuming where the gain is.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: A vendor claims a 40% time saving. Which question is most useful?

choice.div: Faster at which step, for which cases, against what baseline, including whose review time?

div.p: A percentage without scope is marketing. The four questions locate the claim.

choiceresponse.p: Which costs belong in the change calculation? Select all that apply.

choice.div: Review labor added by the new output.

div.p: Net gain includes review, rework, license, implementation and training. Unrelated spending is not part of the case.
